info.title: DNSY REST API
info.description: Management API of the DNSY DNS server. Errors are RFC 9457 problem+json.

post.summary: Create the first admin with the one-time code printed at startup.
Log in with username and password; sets the session and CSRF cookies.
End the current session and clear the cookies.

get.summary: The authenticated caller.

put.summary: Change the caller's password. Ends all sessions and starts a new one for this client.

403.description: A file path or private target needs the admin scope

422.description: Invalid source or SSRF target refused

204.description: Deleted; its entries leave the filter

422.description: The fetch failed; the previous list stays active

get.summary: Live cache statistics.

delete.summary: Remove the entries of one name, optionally with its subtree. Needs `api:write`.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Domain name whose entries are removed.

parameters.name: subtree
parameters.description: Also remove everything below the name (default false).

post.summary:
Export the zone keys as a bundle encrypted under the given passphrase, for backup. The
response holds ciphertext only; the passphrase and the keys are never logged. Refused with
403 when the API listener is plain HTTP.

403.description: Admin scope missing, or the API listener is plain HTTP

post.summary:
Change the key passphrase: every stored private key is re-encrypted under the new one in a
single transaction (all or none). Keys stored unencrypted become encrypted. The running
server uses the new passphrase at once; update `DNSY_DNSSEC_PASSPHRASE` or the passphrase
file before the next start, or the keys cannot be read.

get.summary: Validation counters of the last 24 hours and whether the clock is trusted.
Search the query log, newest first.

parameters.name: client
parameters.description: Exact client address (the network address when client redaction is on).

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of the query name.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Query type by name (`A`, `AAAA`, ...) or number.

parameters.name: outcome
parameters.description: Response code by name (`NOERROR`, `NXDOMAIN`, ...) or number.

get.summary: Live tail of the query log as server-sent events.
get.description:
Events are named `query` and carry one log record as JSON; `lagged` means rows were
skipped because the consumer was too slow. The server polls at its own pace, so a slow
consumer never makes it buffer. The number of concurrent streams is capped (429 beyond).
Takes the same filters as the search (`from`/`to` bound the stream). Needs `api:write`
(operator or admin).

parameters.name: client
parameters.description: Exact client address (the network address when client redaction is on).

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of the query name.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Query type by name (`A`, `AAAA`, ...) or number.

parameters.name: outcome
parameters.description: Response code by name (`NOERROR`, `NXDOMAIN`, ...) or number.

422.description: Invalid or too many entries; nothing changed
Unknown field or invalid value; nothing changed

get.summary: Validation mode, negative trust anchors and the (read-only) trust anchors.

patch.summary:
Change the validation mode or the negative trust anchors at run time. A change flushes the
resolver cache.

get.summary: Totals, answer sources, DNSSEC status counts, cache hit ratio, blocked ratio and latency.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive start, unix milliseconds (default: `to` minus 24 hours).

get.summary: Query counts per bucket (only buckets with data), oldest first.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive start, unix milliseconds (default: `to` minus 24 hours).

parameters.name: bucket
parameters.description: Bucket width in seconds, a multiple of 60 (default 3600).

get.summary: Most blocked names.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive start, unix milliseconds (default: `to` minus 24 hours).

get.summary: Busiest clients (network addresses when client redaction is on).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive start, unix milliseconds (default: `to` minus 24 hours).

get.summary: Most queried names.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive start, unix milliseconds (default: `to` minus 24 hours).

get.summary: List the caller's tokens; admins see everyone's.

post.summary: Create a token for the caller. Needs a session, so a token cannot mint tokens.

201.description: Created; the secret is in this response only

403.description: Not a session, or a scope the role does not allow

422.description: Name over 128 characters, or 100 tokens already

delete.summary: Revoke a token (own tokens; admins any).

503.description: The server is not running upstream groups

422.description: A group keeps at least one member

get.summary: List all users.
Get one user.

delete.summary:
Delete a user. Their tokens and sessions go with them. The last active admin cannot be
deleted.

patch.summary: Change a user's role, reset the password, and/or disable or enable the user.

409.description: Would demote or disable the last active admin

get.summary: The server version.
List zones.
Get a zone, with its `load_error` and an `ETag`.

put.summary: Replace a zone's settings and records. The DNSSEC policy is kept; the serial is bumped.

delete.summary: Delete a zone and its file.

get.summary: A zone's DNSSEC policy, keys and rollover state.

put.summary:
Enable, disable or change a zone's signing policy. Writes the zone file's `dnssec` block;
enabling creates the keys and signs the zone before the response is sent.

get.summary:
DS records (SHA-256 and SHA-384) and DNSKEY records of the zone's KSKs and CSKs, for the
parent zone or registrar. JSON by default; `Accept: text/plain` returns zone-file lines.

200.description: DS and DNSKEY records; `text/plain` (zone-file lines) when asked for by `Accept`

get.summary: The zone's keys (public metadata only), including removed ones.

post.summary:
Generate a key in the `generated` state (not yet published). The zone needs signing
enabled.
Record that the key's DS is published at the parent; a KSK or CSK rollover waits for this.

Start a rollover of the role of an active key: a new key is generated and published, and
the rollover state machine moves it along. KSK and CSK rollovers wait for
`ds-confirmed`.

Abort the rollover of one role (or of every role): the incoming key is withdrawn and its
private key destroyed, and the active key keeps signing. A rollover whose new key already
became active cannot be aborted. If the incoming KSK or CSK's DS was already published at
the parent, remove it there.

200.description: The zone's DNSSEC state after the abort

get.summary: Download the zone as a BIND master file, unsigned or (`signed=true`) with its DNSSEC records.

parameters.name: signed
parameters.description: Export the signed zone: adds DNSKEY, RRSIG, NSEC or NSEC3 and NSEC3PARAM records.

409.description: `signed=true` for a zone that is not signed

get.summary: List records of a zone (paged). The SOA is part of the zone detail, not listed here.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Only this owner name (relative or absolute).

post.summary: Add a record. The SOA serial is bumped.

ETag.description: Validator of the zone after the write

422.description: Invalid name, rdata or TTL, or a CNAME conflict

put.summary: Replace a record. The id changes when name, type or value change. The serial is bumped.

ETag.description: Validator of the zone after the write

422.description: Invalid name, rdata or TTL, a CNAME conflict, or the last apex NS removed

delete.summary: Delete a record. The apex keeps at least one NS record. The serial is bumped.

ETag.description: Validator of the zone after the write

422.description: The last apex NS record cannot be removed

get.summary: The process is up.
The process can serve requests (the database answers).

503.description: Not ready: the database does not answer, or a DNSSEC zone cannot be signed (`dnssec_signing_failed`)

oneOf.description: Abort only this role's rollover; omitted aborts every rollover of the zone.

default_action.description: Applied to clients no rule matches.

rate_limit_qps.description: Queries per second per client; 0 means unlimited.

cidr.description: Network the rule matches (host bits cleared), for address rules.

client_cert_sha256.description: SHA-256 fingerprint (hex) of an mTLS client certificate, for identity rules.

Action.description: What to do with a matching client.

BlocklistView.description: A blocklist source and the status of its last fetch.

allow_private.description: Private and loopback targets (and file paths) are allowed for this source.

entries.description: Entries loaded from the last successful fetch.

last_fetched.description: Unix seconds of the last fetch attempt.

last_status.description: Outcome of the last fetch attempt.

code.description: The one-time code printed to stderr at startup.

max_ttl.description: Highest TTL (seconds) given to cached positive answers.

min_ttl.description: Lowest TTL (seconds) given to cached positive answers.

new_passphrase.description: The new key passphrase (at least 12 characters).

expires_at.description: Unix seconds; the certificate is refused from then on.

sha256.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the DER certificate, lowercase hex.

CreateAclRule.description: New rule: exactly one of `cidr` and `client_cert_sha256`.

cidr.description: Address or network, e.g. `203.0.113.7` or `10.0.0.0/8` (longest prefix wins).

client_cert_sha256.description: SHA-256 fingerprint (64 hex digits) of an mTLS client certificate.

allow_private.description: Allow private, loopback and link-local targets. Needs the `admin` scope.

location.description: `http://` or `https://` URL, or a file path (file paths need the `admin` scope).

expires_at.description: Unix seconds in the future; omit for no expiry.

sha256.description: SHA-256 fingerprint: 64 hex digits, optionally colon separated.

domain.description: Domain name, e.g. `ads.example.com`; subdomains match too.

expires_at.description: Unix seconds; omit for a token that does not expire.

scopes.description: Must be allowed by the caller's role.

CreateZone.description: New zone: the name plus the settings and records of a zone body.

records.description: Must contain at least one NS record at the apex.

CreatedToken.description: The only response that contains the token secret.

token.description: The secret. Store it now; it cannot be retrieved again.

DnskeyRecordView.description: A DNSKEY record, for registrars that take keys instead of digests.

DnssecPolicyInput.description:
Signing policy of a zone. Omitted fields keep their current value (the defaults for a zone
that never had a policy).

algorithm.description: 13 (ECDSAP256SHA256) or 15 (Ed25519). Existing keys are replaced only by a rollover.

enabled.description: Sign the zone. Turning it on creates the zone's keys.

propagation_delay.description:
Seconds added to the DNSKEY TTL before a published key may sign (default 3600,
at most 604800).

clock_trusted.description: False while the system clock is before the build time: validation is suspended.

counters.description:
Answers in the window by DNSSEC status (`unchecked`, `secure`, `insecure`, `bogus`,
`indeterminate`).

oneOf.description: `None` while the validation control is not wired.

window_ms.description: Window of the counters, milliseconds, ending now.

keys_encrypted.description: Private keys are encrypted at rest (a key passphrase is configured).

next_resign.description: Unix time from which signatures are refreshed; `None` while the zone is unsigned.

ds.description: SHA-256 first, then SHA-384, for each published or active KSK or CSK.

DsRecordView.description: A DS record to publish at the parent.

passphrase.description:
Passphrase the bundle is encrypted under (at least 12 characters). It may differ from
the key passphrase; keep it apart from the bundle.

zone.description: Export only this zone's keys; omitted exports every zone's.

algorithm.description: 13 or 15; defaults to the zone policy's algorithm.

GroupBody.description: Group definition for create and replace.

default.description: Receives queries no domain pattern matches. Exactly one group is the default.

GroupView.description: A group with its members and, when the server is running, their health.

available.description: Not ejected by the passive health check.

latency_ms.description: Smoothed round-trip time; absent until measured.

bundle.description:
Base64 of the bundle: every non-removed key, sealed with AES-256-GCM under a key
derived from the request's passphrase. `dnsy dnssec keys import` restores it.

KeyLayoutBody.description: Whether one key signs everything or keys are split into KSK and ZSK.

KeyView.description: Public metadata of a key. There is no private key field.

ds_confirmed_at.description: When the operator confirmed the DS at the parent (KSK and CSK).

per_client_qps.description: Queries per second per client; 0 means unlimited.

LogPageBody.description: A page of the query log, newest first.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; absent on the last page.

client.description: Client address (truncated to its network when redaction is on).

principal.description: Authenticated principal (`DoH` token name), never a token secret.

MemberInput.description: A member as written by a client.

weight.description: Used by the `weighted` strategy; 1 to 1000, default 1.

allow_nonzero_iterations.description: Accept a non-zero iteration count despite RFC 9276.

iterations.description: Extra hash iterations; 0 unless `allow_nonzero_iterations` is set.

salt.description: Salt in hexadecimal; empty for none.

NtaEntryInput.description: A negative trust anchor with an optional expiry.

expires_at.description:
Unix time (in the future) at which the anchor stops applying; omitted keeps it until
removed.

NtaInput.description: A negative trust anchor to set: a bare name, or a name with an optional expiry.

NtaView.description: A negative trust anchor in force.

expires_at.description: Unix time at which the anchor stops applying; `None` until it is removed.

PassphraseChanged.description: Result of a key passphrase change.

keys_reencrypted.description: Keys re-encrypted under the new passphrase.

PatchBlocklist.description: Fields of a source that can change.

detail.description: Explanation specific to this occurrence. Never contains secrets.

retry_after_secs.description: Seconds to wait before retrying (only on 429).

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the problem type.

qps.description: Queries per second per client; 0 disables limiting. At most 1,000,000.

warnings.description:
Conditions that do not stop serving but need attention. `dnssec_clock_untrusted`: the
system clock is before the build time, so DNSSEC validation is suspended.

RecordInput.description: A record as written by a client.

name.description: `@`, a name relative to the zone, or an absolute name ending in a dot.

ttl.description: Seconds; defaults to the zone default TTL.

type.description: A, AAAA, NS, CNAME, PTR, MX, TXT, SRV or CAA.

total.description: Records matching the filters, across all pages.

id.description: Stable id: hash of owner name, type and value.

entries.description: Block plus allow entries now loaded (only when `updated`).

cidrs.description:
Addresses or networks, e.g. `10.0.0.0/8` or `192.0.2.1`. An upstream answer with an A or
AAAA record inside any of them is blocked (EDE 15). An empty list disables the policy.

algorithm.description: Algorithm of the new key (13 or 15); defaults to the rolled key's algorithm.

RolloverRoleView.description: One rollover under way: a role with an incoming key.

new_key_id.description: The incoming key of the first rollover in `rollovers`.

role.description: Role of the first rollover in `rollovers`; use `rollovers` to see them all.

rollovers.description: Every rollover under way (a KSK and a ZSK rollover can run at the same time).

state.description:
`idle`, `in_progress`, or `awaiting_ds_confirmation` when any rollover waits for the
registrar's DS.

RuleView.description: A custom rule: the domain and everything below it. Allow beats block.

SettingsPatch.description: Partial update: omitted fields keep their value.

SettingsView.description: The settings that can change at runtime.

SoaBody.description: The SOA record of a zone.

rname.description: Responsible mailbox, as a domain name.

serial.description: Initial serial on create (default 1). Ignored on replace: every write bumps the serial.

ttl.description: TTL of the SOA record; defaults to the zone default TTL.

StrategyView.description: How a group orders its members.

blocked.description: Answers blocked by a blocklist or rule.

blocked_ratio.description: `blocked / total`, 0 when there are no queries.

querylog_dropped.description:
Query-log events lost since the server started: the channel was full or a batch failed to
write. Not limited to the requested range.

querylog_flush_errors.description: Query-log batches that failed to write since the server started.

TokenInfo.description: Token metadata. The secret is never part of it.

TrustAnchorView.description: A configured trust anchor (read-only; set in the configuration file).

owner.description: Zone the anchor belongs to (`.` for the root).

UpdateUser.description: Fields to change; absent fields stay as they are.

disabled.description:
`true` disables the user (sessions end at once, tokens are refused, login fails);
`false` enables them again. The last active admin cannot be disabled.

password.description: Reset the password (at least 8 characters); ends all of the user's sessions.

role.description: Changing the role ends all of the user's sessions.

UserInfo.description: A user account. Never carries password material.

disabled.description: A disabled user cannot log in and their tokens are refused.

disabled_at.description: Unix seconds when the user was disabled.

ValidationPatch.description:
Validation settings changes. Applied at once; not persisted across restarts (the
configuration file is the source at startup). Changing the mode or the negative trust
anchors flushes the cache.

negative_trust_anchors.description:
Replaces the whole list; `[]` clears it. An entry is a name, or `{name, expires_at}`
for an anchor that stops applying at `expires_at` (Unix time).

negative_trust_anchor_entries.description: The same anchors with their expiry.

negative_trust_anchors.description: Names at or below which validation is skipped (RFC 7646); expired entries are left out.

ZoneBody.description: Settings and records of a zone, for create and replace.

records.description: Must contain at least one NS record at the apex.

ZoneDetail.description: A zone with its SOA (no records; see `/zones/{name}/records`).

load_error.description: Why the zone file on disk is not being served, if its latest version is invalid.
